decode_rules: Read stdout/stderr separately in bounded chunks; cap cumulative bytes at configured limits, never collect unlimited communicate output.
Stdout must decode UTF-8, exactly one JSON object, no duplicate keys/nonfinite numbers/trailing non-whitespace; structural depth<=32 before recursive decode.
Build envelope with observed subprocess returncode, never a code extracted from child JSON.
Reject missing required fields and unknown properties; code/output mismatch is PROTOCOL_FAILURE unless an execution fault was independently observed.
post_schema_predicates: All lists of identifiers contain unique items.
gaps is a subset of required_obligations; material_gap iff gap_reasons is nonempty.
Failure event requires nonempty failure_cases; success requires no gaps, all_success, delegation_current, scope_supported and at least one required obligation.
PARTIAL/NOT_ASSESSED never establishes absence of failures; evidence_verification remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.
manifest: checker-binding.json pins source files; Python and dependency versions recorded at implementation/deployment; unsupported versions refused, not silently accepted.
privacy: Raw payload only transient. Receipt stores whitelisted enum/count/digest fields; never free-text error/limits/observation/rationale or absolute paths.
limits: Source-reviewed adapter and synthetic examples, not exhaustiveness proof of every possible checker execution.
Oversized error output is a protocol/capture failure, not silently truncated valid JSON.
Runtime child failure takes precedence over payload validity.
